title: Mamie Lee Kelly, Gus Wick and Williams's marriage
summary: Further about Mamie Lee Kelly, who never paid him, where she came from, then his marriage, his wife's death and his job as a bank guard.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
